description: This file is a shell script designed to test the Git hook infrastructure, including setup, execution, and validation of various Git hooks (pre-receive, update, post-receive, post-update). It automates creating repositories, configuring hooks, and verifying their outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a block of commands expected to succeed in the test sequence.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a file is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test sequence.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers, used for creating multiple test inputs.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: A helper for setting up and managing test hooks in the Git repository.
